svg.title: Silhouette halls backdrop, night 2: bunk to latrine
svg.desc: Silhouette halls backdrop for night 2, bunk to latrine: the tall hall side-on as a lit cream sheet, windows at 3.5 m throwing light long and down, the pipe run at 2.7 m, claw marks higher than a man; bunk doors with a lever high and a knob low, the latrine at the end, one drain, and a print forty centimetres long frozen into the floor.
